lines.en: I move along the tomb's wall.

lines.zh: 我的杖在地上轻轻点着
lines.en: My staff taps the floor lightly.
Each step I take is deliberate.
I step around the bone piles.
My robe sweeps the flagstones.

lines.zh: 我沿着柱子往后退了三步。
lines.en: I back three steps along the pillars.
I move slowly, keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 我在找能放法术的地方
lines.en: I am looking for a place to cast from.
I descend the stairs.
My hand stays raised.
I cross to the far end of the passage.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里换了个位置
lines.en: I shift position inside the shadows.
I hold my staff up and wait.

lines.zh: 这座墓穴干得没有一点水汽
lines.en: This tomb is dry as bone.
I listen to footsteps far off.
My fingers tap the staff.
I am a little far from you.

lines.zh: 我在估你到我这儿的距离
lines.en: I am judging the distance you must cross.
The words circle in my mouth.
I draw in a slow breath of cold air.
My amulet swings once.
I wait; there is no hurry.
You have come three steps closer.

lines.zh: 你的手一动，我的咒就起。
lines.en: Your hand moves; my spell begins.

lines.zh: 活人的热气在我杖上凝霜。
lines.en: Your living warmth frosts over on my staff.
I do not like close quarters.
One more step and I strike.
My staff points at you.
I am working out the remaining distance.
I have eyes behind the pillars too.
This tomb does not welcome you.
I know that stance.

lines.zh: 我身上的骨头响了一声
lines.en: My bones give one clatter.
I slip into the pillar's shadow.
That broke my incantation.
I nearly came apart.
A tear opens in my robe.
I brace against the wall.
I am too close to you.
I cannot catch my breath, nor do I need to.
I am keeping that in mind.
Bones scatter; I gather them up again.
The dead do not eat that.

lines.zh: 你举着那玩意儿做什么
lines.en: What are you holding that thing up for?
Even alive, I was never greedy.
Keep those things to yourself.
That is no use to bone.
I have no use for such things now.
You brought food into a tomb.
I gave it a single glance.
That is blocking my view.

lines.zh: 那点东西你趁早收回去
lines.en: Take that little thing back now.
You ran right into me.
I step back to make space.
The bump nearly topples me.
Do not press up so close.
I nearly dropped my staff.

lines.zh: 我的袍角一扯，咒就断了。
lines.en: My hem snags, and the chant breaks.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，骨头发响
lines.en: We collide, and bones knock.
I push you off and back away.
Do not walk against my bones.
I set my heels.
I have been dead a long time.
Such things went into the ground with me.
Such matters are not on my mind.
I am alone in this tomb.
No need to raise that subject.
I turn my whole body away.
Guarding this place is enough.
You are asking the wrong one.
I raise my staff.
I go on with the chant.

lines.zh: 掉在这块砖上的，我收着。
lines.en: Whatever falls on this flagstone, I keep.
I hook it up with my staff.
This is rather old.

lines.zh: 这物件上的尘土比我还老。
lines.en: The dust on this is older than I am.

lines.zh: 它从我的指骨间滑掉了
lines.en: It slips through my finger bones.

lines.zh: 落在这儿的东西归墓地
lines.en: What falls here belongs to the tomb.
I tuck it into my robe.
This might buy me some strength.
Holding it is unpleasant.
This little thing is nothing.
You stepped into the passage.
My staff is already up.
You are close enough now.
I waited for exactly this.
The words are already spoken.
That little light on you is too bright.

lines.zh: 我不打算让你再往里走
lines.en: You will go no deeper.
I keep this tomb.
I strike first on my side.
My staff tip is on you now.
My staff tip has lit up.
You should not have come.
I can kill you from here.
I slip behind the pillar.
Do not think distance saves you.
I finish the last word.

lines.zh: 我封住了你想退的那条廊。
lines.en: I have sealed the gallery you meant to retreat down.
I keep my distance from you.
My staff tip follows you.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我就退一步
lines.en: Each step you take, I take one back.
The spell gathers in my hand.
I wait for you to stop.
The closer you get, the weaker I am.
I will not let you close.
My hem stirs.
You cannot tell where I am.
The stones block your view.
I move between the pillars.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经抬起来了
lines.en: My fingers are raised.

lines.zh: 你听见念咒的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the chanting?

lines.zh: 这声音不是从我这来的
lines.en: That sound is not from me.

lines.zh: 我咒文的最后一个字快成了。
lines.en: The last word of my chant is nearly done.
Your shadow falls on the wall.

lines.zh: 我在等你走到那块地上
lines.en: I wait for you to reach that spot.
I have prepared this ground.
You have stepped onto that ground.
This is the moment I waited for.
I release a bolt of light.
The magic strikes you.
You fell back a step, good.
My staff taps once.

lines.zh: 这一下离你很远，却打中了
lines.en: That came from far off and still hit.
I use the gap to retreat.
Do not come any nearer.
My amulet flares.
You are smoking.

lines.zh: 我的杖尖又亮起一小团。
lines.en: A small light gathers on my staff again.
My fingers are cold.
Any closer and I will not hold.

lines.zh: 这一道光我自己也嫌弱。
lines.en: Even I find that bolt weak.
A scorch mark is left on the floor.
I retreat into the shadow.
The chant has not stopped in my mouth.
I rise beside the stone coffin.
Another shadow joins the passage.
I raise my staff and the light comes.
This tomb needs a keeper.
I came up from a deeper level.
My bones rattle before I stand steady.
My robe is still full of earth.
I straighten my amulet.
The air here is very dry.
I begin to chant, slowly.

lines.zh: 我选了个远一点的位置
lines.en: I chose a spot further back.

lines.zh: 我杖上的灰落了一层又一层。
lines.en: Dust settles on my staff, layer after layer.
I heard someone come in.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼窝里亮了一下
lines.en: I lift my head, and my eye sockets glow.

lines.zh: 火把的火焰舔着我的袍子
lines.en: Torch fire licks my robe.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，骨头散了
lines.en: I tumble down the steps and rattle apart.

lines.zh: 墓里的水灌进我的胸腔
lines.en: Tomb water floods my ribcage.
The blast throws me onto the coffin.
An arrow passes between my ribs.
Magic snaps my incantation.
I have long had no need to eat.
Lightning runs down the passage.
The flagstones are gone.
